name: Shoujo Rensa ~Heart of the Distortion~
original_name: 少女連鎖 ～Heart of the distortion～
source:
Main character is invited to a mansion as a tutor for a girl. There he is forcibly restrained and deprived of virginity. Gradually, the hidden M nature starts to bloom...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
